title: Statistical attribute alignment for black-box generative AI via output post-processing
why_read: A practical post-processing method to statistically steer black-box generative AI outputs toward a target attribute distribution, relevant to fairness and synthetic data work.
analysis: This paper tackles a concrete, practical problem: given only query access to a generative model (no internals), how do you select outputs so the overall attribute distribution (e.g. demographic balance in generated images) matches a target, using as few queries as possible. It provides algorithms with provable query-efficiency and near-optimality as the number of outputs grows, tested on text-to-image and synthetic persona generation. This is useful for engineers building fairness-aware or representative synthetic datasets on top of commercial APIs where you can't retrain or fine-tune the underlying model.
